profile     @podman-socket
            Containers via a filtering proxy over a per-sandbox podman engine. Includes @net (interim: containers run on the engine's network — see .claude/design/ENGINE-NETNS.md).
defined in  builtin:base.toml

  includes         @sys
                   @home
                   @net
  ro               /etc/containers
  optional         /etc/containers

To see what this actually produces for a directory:
  snug --dry-run -p @podman-socket <dir>
